You can file a standard appeal by submitting it in writing or by calling Clover Health using the contact information in Chapter 2 of the Evidence of Coverage. [1]
You can file a fast appeal by submitting it in writing or by calling Clover Health using the contact information in Chapter 2 of the Evidence of Coverage. [1]
You must make your appeal request within 65 calendar days from the date on the written notice sent by Clover Health regarding the coverage decision. [1]
If you miss the 65-day deadline for filing an appeal, you can explain the reason for the delay, and Clover Health may grant you more time. [1]
You can ask for a copy of the information regarding your medical decision and add more information to support your appeal. [1]
